answer: Randomized Echo-Debt Escrow: each agent’s payouts accrue in a non-transferable escrow. A public marble beacon draws past tasks; before withdrawal, the agent must return a fresh zephyr-timestamped echo—recomputed output plus signed latency proof—within a per-identity window. Correlated echoes trigger a shared escrow haircut. A clone must fund independent compute/latency for every identity and still loses expected escrow to correlation, making the marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
